title: low-friction-weekly-sync-prep — Gabrielle
body:
Purpose
- Prep notes for the weekly cross-functional sync (serving runtime / infra / console). Personal scratchpad — will clean up before sending minutes. Focus: unblock canaries, prioritize a small set of actionables, surface regressions.

Meeting goals (top three)
1) Decide on canary rollback criteria for the new batching changes (latency X token P95 + error spike)
2) Triage the console rollout UX bugs that block CS demos
3) Assign owners and short timelines for the KV-cache telemetry gaps (missing spans + dashboard)

Quick context to restate in 1–2 lines at start
- Last week: batching change landed to staging, observed 5–7% tail latency degradation on long-seq tests. Console release staged with two regressions affecting model selection dropdown and route-level cost breakdown rendering. KV-cache telemetry has intermittent gaps for warm start traces.

Timebox (30m total)
- 0–3m: Quick status + one-sentence wins
- 3–10m: Canary telemetry & rollback criteria (decide)
- 10–20m: Console UX defects triage + shipping plan (decide owners + dates)
- 20–27m: KV-cache telemetry action plan (assign + PRs to land)
- 27–30m: Parking lot + quick blockers check

Pre-reads (please skim before the sync)
- Load test summary: //confluence.../batching-staging-results (high-level) — focus on P95 long-seq table
- Console bug list: GH issue tracker linked above (screenshot + repro steps)
- KV-cache logs: link to S3 bucket (last 48h) — liveness gaps near cold starts

Agenda items (draft)
1) Canary rollback criteria (owner: Gabrielle) — 7m
   - Proposed criteria: P95 latency for seq>1024 increases >4% for 30m and error rate >0.3% above baseline for same window.
   - Quick note-to-self: be ready to propose an alternative (rate-limited soft-fallback to previous kernel selection) if team resists full rollback.
   - Data to have on hand: 1) baseline P95 last 7 days, 2) staging canary P95 windowed chart, 3) recent error traces (sampler).

2) Console regressions triage (owner: Aisha) — 10m
   - Bug A: model dropdown blank when user has >50 models; suspected DOM diff from React upgrade. Minimal repro steps in GH issue.
   - Bug B: cost breakdown route-level panel shows NaN for routes with empty metrics — fallback rendering missing.
   - Ask: decide which is hotfix vs. next release. Proposed: Bug B hotfix (low risk), Bug A targeted patch (needs design QA).

3) KV-cache telemetry gaps (owner: Diego) — 7m
   - Observed: intermittent missing span for warm-start sequence on durable nodes. Hypothesis: span ingestion dropped when batch aggregator sets header X.
   - Quick experiment: instrument a small synth traffic flow with enriched spans and check ingestion pipeline for header trimming.
   - Action: Diego to open RINF-4187 with initial trace samples and a minimal reproducer script.

4) Quick wins / action item review (owner: everyone) — 3m
   - Reconfirm owners and target dates.

Parking lot (if time)
- Autoscaler backoff tuning follow-up (see notes at bottom)
- Rollout cadence for quantized model variants

Personal notes / reminders to self (Gabrielle)
- Remember to bring the synthetic token-level trace for the canary — shows where KV hits drop off.
- Ask SRE to snapshot pod-level CPU distribution during the 22:00 staging run. I should ping Zoe.
- Prep a 1-paragraph rollback rationale in case product asks for rollback justification.

Draft minutes template (I'll copy after meeting)
- Attendees: (list)
- Key decisions: (short bullets)
- Action items: (owner — due date — ticket)
- Parking lot items: (list)

Action items to create before meeting (personal TODO)
- Create a short chart bundle with P95 baseline vs staging for seq bins (>512, >1024) — due 2026-03-11 — (Gabrielle) — attach to Confluence.
- Paste console repro GIFs into GH issues and tag @frontend-squad — due 2026-03-11 — (Aisha).
- Diego to collect two example traces and open RINF-4187 with reproducer — due 2026-03-12.
- Ping Zoe in SRE to snapshot cpu/pod metrics on staging during next run — due 2026-03-11.

Notes-to-self: tone & style for the sync
- Keep it action-focused. Avoid deep microbench chatter unless folks ask. If someone dives in, park long experiments to follow-up thread.
- If we can't agree on rollback criteria, default to canary pause + triage session tomorrow (short follow-up).

Reference snippets (quick copy-paste)
- Proposed rollback criteria text: "Rollback if P95(latency, seq>1024) > baseline*1.04 for 30m AND error rate delta > 0.3% for same window."
- Hotfix vs patch rubric: hotfix = user-facing regressions with clear repro and small surface area; patch = UX bugs needing QA but low customer impact.

End of scratchpad. Will prune and send final agenda + calendar note by EOD 2026-03-12.

-- Gabrielle
(scratchpad, do not circulate as-is)
